items.statement: Receivables nearly doubled due to extended credit terms for a legacy client to 45 days and new customers on higher credit terms; targeting 50-55 days cash conversion cycle
items.quote: So on the receivables part, you are right the receivables have doubled, almost doubled. So the reason behind this is there are two reasons. One is that we had to extend the credit terms for key existing customers from the existing terms to 45 days in order to support the revenue generation.

items.statement: Receivables increased due to extended credit terms for a legacy client to 45 days and new customer onboarding on higher credit terms; targeting 50-55 days cash conversion cycle
items.quote: One is that we had to extend the credit terms for one of our legacy clients to 45 days to support the revenue transition. And the second is the new customer onboarding that we have done in the second half of FY '24 and in FY '25.

items.statement: Investor Global sold about 40% of its holding after buying at INR38 and seeing the price reach INR100-odd.
items.quote: They have purchased the share at INR38, invested global. They have sold, I think, about 40% of their portfolio. 40% of the holding because they got about INR100-odd rupees.

items.statement: Management has no plans for further equity dilution as of now; the previous preferential issue was to cross INR75 crores net worth for NSE listing eligibility in FY27.
items.quote: No, no. We don't have any plans of further dilution as of now. The main reason for raising for INR75 crores CR equity in the last year was to get eligible for NSE listing.

items.statement: Negative operating cash flow is considered good as it indicates higher disbursements; the company views cash flow as a measure of money deployed into the market.
items.quote: For us, having a negative cash flow is actually good. It means we are disbursing more money. For us, operating cash flow means how much are we disbursing.

items.statement: Receivables increased substantially in Q1 FY26; 50% of the increment recovered in July; expect working capital improvement through December
items.quote: So you -- in June quarter end, there was substantia l increase in the receivables. So there was some amount of increase in inventory as well. But we think all of this would get paid down between now and December. Already in month of July, almost 50% of increment in the receivable, which we had in the June quarter has be en recovered in last four

items.statement: Expect continued improvement in working capital (DSOs, inventory days) through March 2026 despite short-term increase in Q1
items.quote: For the medium term, that is up to March '26, we ex pect to maintain the trend of continued improvement on working capital in terms of DSOs, da ys outstanding against sales for both inventory as well as receivables, even though in short term in the current quarter they have gone up

items.statement: INR150 crores equity infusion from warrant exercise in Q1 FY26; one-third from promoters, rest from institutions; no outstanding warrants now
items.quote: This was also a quarter where we got the funds comi ng in towards the equity for the warrants, which we had issued earlier, almost to the tune of INR150 crores and that has gone into building of the working capital

items.statement: May raise additional equity for working capital if needed to support growth; will inform stakeholders after Board discussions
items.quote: So at appropriate time, I think post discussions wi th our Board, we'll be informing all the stakeholders of how we plan to raise any additional funds for that purpose

items.statement: Operating cash flow was negative around INR 5 crores in Q1 FY26
items.quote: It was negative around INR 5 crores.

items.statement: Central government project payments are not delayed; any delays are due to usual budget cycles after March
items.quote: Otherwise it's a myth that in central, in central government projects, payment delays. I'm not aware of a state government because I don't do work there, but yeah, central government, the payments are not delayed.
